statement: For a realized Juggler word w, the first positive local remainder sits after a tight even or odd power-of-two prefix. That remainder contributes at least ρ_j^{2^j} to Δ, and the suffix operator Amplify (later remainders dropped) is a lower bound. An odd letter lifts an inserted defect by the exact cubic (x^a+D)^3-x^{3a} ≥ 3 x^{2a} D. Mixed OOE has firstDefect ≤ 1, with Δ ≥ 3 T(n)^4 ρ_0 or Δ ≥ ρ_1^2. These bounds do not claim Δ exceeds the formal surplus.
